maes_6.why: Calculating area and volume requires spatial reasoning that doesn't come naturally to me.

maes_8.why: Fractions are confusing and error-prone for me; I find them difficult to work with.

maes_9.why: Determining missing side lengths involves applying the Pythagorean theorem, which is manageable but not my favorite topic.
